description: Never overstay your welcome , know when it’s time to go. GO! #selflove #letgo #selfcare
transcript: Never overstay your welcome anywhere. There are not many things that are surprises. Experiments always reveal themselves and it's up to us, rather we choose to follow the exit sign or if we avoid it and take the stairs to the next floor because we think that next floor is going to be better. Attention always guides me where I need to be, and intention always reveals the external world's intentions. Pay close attention and never overstay your welcome.
